description: Default detection profile for Anime Expeditions fishing minigame

fish_detection.comment: Fish icon has TWO states: light blue while free (hsv_lower/upper) and white with a bold outline while the zone touches it (hover_hsv_lower/upper). Both masks are OR-ed

zone_detection.comment: Bright saturated blue zone fill: high V lower bound excludes the dark bar background; close_kernel must be wider than the fish icon
